title: Generate API resource tokens from an OpenAPI spec

specPath.description: Path or https:// URL to the OpenAPI 3.x YAML or JSON spec file

outputDir.description: Output directory for generated files (relative to workspace root)

baseUrlToken.description: Name of the InjectionToken holding the API base URL

tagFilter.description: Comma-separated list of OpenAPI tags to include (empty = all tags)

namingConvention.description: File naming convention: kebab-case filenames with SCREAMING_SNAKE token names

providedIn.description: none: token has no factory; a provide{Name}() helper is exported for explicit scoped provision. root: token self-registers at root (tree-shakeable singleton, no multi-context support)

includeMocks.description: Generate a .mock.ts file per endpoint (and index.mock.ts barrels) using @constantant/openapi-resource-mocks. Requires the package to be installed.

specId.description: Identifier for this API spec, embedded in MockResourceMeta and mocks.manifest.json. Defaults to baseUrlToken lowercased with _BASE_URL stripped (e.g. PETSTORE_BASE_URL → petstore).

verbose.description: Print a summary of created, updated, and deleted files after generation.

dateType.description: Convert format:date-time / format:date response fields to Date or Temporal objects. Emits a typed XxxRevived alias and reviveXxxDates() helper per affected endpoint.

readonlyResponses.description: Wrap all XxxResponse and XxxError type aliases in Readonly<> to prevent accidental mutation of response data.

includeMswHandlers.description: Generate a .msw.ts file per endpoint (and index.msw.ts barrels) with MSW 2.x http.* handlers. Requires msw to be installed.
